text_block_list.text: —The Satsuki Sho. Since it wasn't our target, the final prep is incomplete, but...
Even so, I decided to enter the race. The goal was—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Today is... mostly for scouting, right?
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's see what our rivals are made of.
Right, let's see what our rivals are made of.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, going toe-to-toe gives you a completely different level
of precision compared to just observing from the outside.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Show me, Rose, Pisa, Flash Sun.
Show me just how mighty pieces you truly are on this board.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Now, the Satsuki Sho is finally about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Once again this year, many wonderful Umamusume
have gathered for this opening race!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And the one drawing the absolute most attention is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa!
She is currently seen as one of the top contenders.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... this... halo...
Could it be... the sparkle of pure talent?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad... truly.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Thank goodness...? What is?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-san. Now that you've been able to enter
the Satsuki Sho, with this...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Everything connects.
Towards the greatest Japan Derby,
all of us together.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (They're glad that I'm racing...?)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Does she not care about winning...?
Is she fine as long as her generation
just gets along happily together...?)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-san, Rose-san, Flash-san, and me.
All of us competing together—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"We shall reach heights no one has ever seen before.
I shall—lead the way."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—!?
No, you're...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(She hasn't thrown the match.
She's trying to raise the overall level of competition
before taking the win...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you're aiming for
a synergy effect, then.
As expected of an angel...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Very well. I shall bear witness, Pisa.
Heading toward the Japanese Derby—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...just what level it is that you truly desire.
